methodology.sampling: Paired rounds, alternating before/after order; fresh process per sample; warm filesystem cache, cold JS process/JIT
methodology.nativeTimer: Wall-clock spawnSync of native text CLI, including startup and captured output
methodology.jsTimer: Worker performance.now: SourceCode queries exclude parser/setup; plugin includes all of Linter.verify; process wall time also retained
methodology.validation: Before timing: equal complete parsed native JSON and exact text stdout/stderr; JS complete API outputs/messages hashed. Every timing sample must retain matching output
methodology.memory: Optional native-only system time RSS measurements, separate from timing; worker nodePeakRssKiB is Node self high-water RSS captured before result hashing and excludes native subprocesses
